title: Script for providers/fake.py (pytest only; never selectable from server.py)
description: Format of the fake provider's JSON fixture. exec(cmd): entries are tried in order; the first entry whose `match` (re.search on the command) matches and whose `times` is not used up answers; `times` defaults to 1. An entry with `times: 0` never runs out (repeats forever). A command no entry answers raises ScriptError, so a test fails loudly instead of inventing output. After an entry answers, its `writes` are added to the file table that stat()/fetch() read. The fake never runs anything.

files.description: files present before any command, by path
